description: This is a Python script for migrating verification tokens from a CSV file into a database using Prisma ORM. It includes functions for parsing CSV values, connecting to the database, reading CSV data, and inserting records while avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: parse_csv_value
methods.description: Parses CSV string values into appropriate Python data types based on the specified field type.

methods.name: migrate_verification_tokens
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that reads verification token data from a CSV file and migrates it into the database, skipping duplicates and handling errors.
